post.title: Is your bonus really taxed more than your salary?
post.ig:
Your bonus isn't taxed more than your salary.
Many employers withhold a flat 22% federal on bonuses (37% on the part over $1M), or use the aggregate method. That's withholding, not the final tax.
At filing, a bonus is wages, taxed at the same 2026 brackets as salary.
Hypothetical: single, $60,000 salary + $5,000 bonus. Taxable income $48,900 stays in the 12% bracket: $600 tax vs $1,100 withheld, a $500 gap back at filing.
Sources: IRS Pub 15 (2026), IRS Pub 525, IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32.
